items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: This fellow, August Russo, who played trombone, he used to do a real good alto player.

ctx.x: He had some tough music. I never used to play with him but I used to hear him.
This fellow, August Russo, who played trombone, he used to do a real good alto player. He quit the alto player and got on the trombone.
That must be the upright alto you're talking about, not the saxophone.
